# NordVolt Mag 10K or a regular power bank: which should you carry?

The NordVolt Mag 10K snaps onto the back of an iPhone, so you can keep using the phone while it charges; a regular power bank needs a cable.

## Which one charges faster?

A cable is faster: the NordVolt Mag 10K charges wirelessly at 15 W, while its USB-C port delivers 20 W.

## How do you set it up?

1. Take off any case thicker than the magnet can hold through.
2. Snap the NordVolt Mag 10K onto the back of the phone.
3. Check that the charging icon appears on the lock screen.

## How do they compare?

| Feature | NordVolt Mag 10K | Regular power bank |
|---|---|---|
| Attachment | Magnetic | Cable |
| Wireless output | 15 W | None |
